preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two nonempty strings s and p separated by a single space.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.isalpha() for c in p) and len(s) <= 200 and len(p) <= 200
postconditions.description: Both strings s and p are nonempty, composed of letters (a-z, A-Z), and have length at most 200.

postconditions.expression: p != '' and s != '' and len(p) <= len(s)
postconditions.description: The hidden phrase p is nonempty, and its length is at most the length of s.
The number of occurrences of p as a subsequence in s is exactly n, where n is the input integer.
